SharedDocumentBundle.description: Immutable request-scoped original text, not generated Markdown or a durable preference update. See docs/INTENT_PREFERENCE_SPEC.md.

SharedCreateRequest.description: intent_md describes this purchase and its temporary constraints/preferences. preference_md is a request-bound preference snapshot; omission/empty text does not clear active SQLite product preferences. Neither field updates the durable profile.

is_final.description: Seller explicitly ends this branch; valid only with an offered outcome.

SharedSellerAgent.description: One Buyer branch for a selected Seller. Backend assigns stop_reason; null means active. IDs and round order require cross-object validation.

product_details.description: Backend-snapshotted public SKU display data; optional for historical snapshots. No private seller policies.

SharedSellerRFQ.description: Seller-local RFQ. Optional competitive_terms contain only Backend-validated, unexpired, de-identified offers from the previous round. No private budget, competitor IDs, transcripts, trust or campaign data.

SharedSellerOfferDraft.description: Untrusted Seller proposal. The Backend assigns offer_id and eligibility after validation.

is_final.description: Seller explicitly ends this branch; valid only with an offered outcome.

withdrawn_offer_ids.description: Optional explicit withdrawal of this Seller's own previously issued offers. Backend verifies ownership; invalid new drafts alone never withdraw old offers.

SharedEvaluatorInput.description: Campaign and Sponsored data are intentionally absent.

gift_exchange_discount_twd.description: Request-wide maximum gift-to-cash concession; defaults to zero. Private Seller policy.

AcpAffiliateAttributionSource.description: Context about where the attribution originated.

url.description: Canonical content URL when type is 'url'.

AcpAffiliateAttributionMetadata.description: Flat key/value map for additional non-sensitive context. Keys must be strings; values must be strings, numbers, or booleans. Arrays and nested objects are NOT permitted.

AcpAffiliateAttribution.description: Optional affiliate attribution data for crediting third-party publishers. Write-only: not returned in responses. Forward compatibility: Servers SHOULD ignore unknown fields to support future extensions (per RFC §8.2).

provider.description: Identifier for the attribution provider / affiliate network namespace (e.g., 'impact.com').

token.description: Opaque provider-issued token for fraud-resistant validation. Treat as secret.

publisher_id.description: Provider-scoped affiliate/publisher identifier. Required if token is omitted.

issued_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the attribution token was issued.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the attribution token expires.

touchpoint.description: Attribution touchpoint type. Use 'first' when capturing at session creation, 'last' when capturing at completion. Enables multi-touch attribution models.

unit_amount.description: The unit price of the line item in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD)

channel.description: Details about the channel used for this 3DS Authentication.

type.description: Use 'browser' to indicate the transaction originated from a browser.

browser.description: Browser details collected server- or client-side.

accept_header.description: The HTTP Accept header from the cardholder’s browser.

ip_address.description: The IP address of the browser.

javascript_enabled.description: Whether the cardholder browser can execute JavaScript.

language.description: An IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the browser language.

color_depth.description: The screen color depth. Required if javascript_enabled is true.

java_enabled.description: Browser Java support. Required if javascript_enabled is true.

screen_height.description: Screen height in pixels. Required if javascript_enabled is true.

screen_width.description: Screen width in pixels. Required if javascript_enabled is true.

timezone_offset.description: Time difference in minutes between UTC and the browser local time. Required if javascript_enabled is true.

acquirer_details.description: Details about the acquirer used for this 3DS Authentication. This object MUST be present.

acquirer_merchant_id.description: The Merchant ID assigned by the acquirer.

merchant_name.description: Merchant name assigned by the acquirer.

requestor_id.description: Requestor ID (if required by the directory server).

directory_server.description: The 3DS directory server used for this Authentication.

flow_preference.description: Contains additional details on the seller's preference for the 3DS authentication flow. Sellers MAY request a preference, but issuers ultimately decide the actual flow.

type.description: Type of flow requested for this 3DS Authentication. 'challenge' requests a challenge flow; 'frictionless' requests a frictionless flow.

challenge.description: Details about the requested challenge flow.

frictionless.description: Details about the requested frictionless flow.

AcpAuthenticationResult.description: Agent-provided authentication results returned to the seller for card-based 3D Secure.

outcome_details.description: Detailed authentication data. This field is required when the outcome is 'authenticated', 'informational', or 'attempt_acknowledged'.

three_ds_cryptogram.description: The 3DS cryptogram (authentication value / AAV/CAVV/AEVV). This value is 20 bytes, base64-encoded into a 28-character string.

electronic_commerce_indicator.description: Electronic Commerce Indicator (ECI) returned by the 3D Secure provider. Indicates the degree/type of authentication performed.

transaction_id.description:
Transaction identifier returned by the 3DS system:
- For 3DS1: the XID
- For 3DS2: the Directory Server Transaction ID (dsTransID)

version.description: The 3D Secure version used for this authentication (for example '1.0.2' or '2.2.0').

reason_code.description: Reason for abandonment. This enum is extensible: servers SHOULD accept unrecognized values and treat them as 'other' (see RFC Section 7.2). Validators SHOULD be configured for lenient enum handling.

trace_summary.description: A generated summary of the specific objection or negotiation gap.
